name: littlelingos-push
description: A bilingual PWA that teaches Chinese-speaking parents the English a native parent would actually say to a 0–6 year-old in real daily-life moments. 30 scenarios × 4 age bands (`0-1`, `1-2`, `2-3`, `3-6`), ~600 phrases, each with native-parent English, aligned Chinese, an action tip, and generated audio. Live at <https://littlelingos.netlify.app>.
